run.procedureSummary:
Read in full: C:\Users\Jaket\AppData\Local\Temp\om\coherence\desk3\concrete.md. Rules as applied, one line per step:
Step 1, Charge: add the cycle's charge-sheet row to forms 1 to 6. No trimming, so a form can sit over capacity.
Step 2, Overtop: walk forms 1 to 6 in order. Any amount above capacity moves into the next form before that form is checked, and the form is left at capacity. Form 6's excess goes to waste.
Step 3, Marks: use the quantities after overtop. A GREEN form goes HOT when quantity >= upper mark. A HOT form goes GREEN when quantity <= lower mark. Otherwise the state stays the same. Each change is logged.
Step 4, Bleed: take a snapshot of all six quantities and states first, then apply every move together. A GREEN form loses floor(q/4) to waste. A HOT form loses floor(q/2) to the form before it, and form 1's HOT bleed goes to waste. No trimming afterwards.
Step 5, Washout: add up the six forms. If the total is over 38 (strictly), each form becomes floor(q/2) and the difference goes to waste. If it is 38 or less, nothing changes. States are not changed here.
Waste tally = form 6 overtop + GREEN evaporation + form 1 HOT bleed + washout removals.

openPoints.point: What 'halve every form, rounded down' leaves in the form: floor(q/2) kept, or floor(q/2) removed
openPoints.assumption: The form keeps floor(q/2) and the rest, ceil(q/2), goes to waste. Example: 7 becomes 3 and 4 goes to waste.

openPoints.point: Which quantities the Marks step reads
openPoints.assumption: The quantities after overtop in the same cycle, so states are set before bleed and washout.

openPoints.point: Which state the Bleed step uses
openPoints.assumption: The state just set by this cycle's Marks step. Amounts come from one snapshot taken before any mix moves, so mix bled into a form in this step does not bleed again in the same step.
Over 38 means strictly greater. In cycle 5 the total after bleed was exactly 38, so washout did not fire.
Both are inclusive: 'at or above' the upper mark and 'at or below' the lower mark. For example, form 5 at 7 against an upper mark of 7 went HOT in cycle 1.
No. States change only in the Marks step.
Only the amount strictly above capacity moves, and the form is left at exactly capacity.
Form 6 overtop 12 (1 in cycle 2, 3 in cycle 3, 8 in cycle 4). GREEN evaporation plus form 1 HOT bleed 18 (1, 4, 6, 5 and 2 in cycles 1 to 5). Washout 46 (21 in cycle 1, 25 in cycle 4). Total 76.
